summary: Toast stack where new toasts spring up from below, hover or focus fans the stack out and pauses timers, and a sideways swipe dismisses.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Render the "Show toast" button under the stack, which shows the next built-in sample.

methods.description: Adds a toast `{ title: string; description?: string; tone?: "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "destructive" }`. Without an argument it shows the next built-in sample.

keyboard.action: On a toast's dismiss button, dismiss it.

accessibility: The stack is one `role="region"` element labelled "Notifications" with `aria-live="polite"`, so a new toast is announced once; toasts carry no live role of their own, and removals are not announced.
Each toast has a native dismiss button labelled "Dismiss" and described by the toast's title. Buttons on toasts hidden at the back of the stack are taken out of the tab order.
Moving focus into the stack expands it and pauses the timers, as hovering does.
Dismissing the focused toast moves focus to the toast behind it, else to the newer one, else to the "Show toast" button, else to the stack. A leaving toast is `inert`.
Swiping is pointer-only; the dismiss button is the keyboard path.
motion: With reduced motion toasts appear, fan out, settle and leave without transitions; a swipe still follows the pointer.
notes: Ships with six sample toasts (published, copied, connector added, upload failed, memory updated, files uploaded) that `show()` cycles through when called without an argument.
Each toast lives 5 s, and timers pause while the stack is expanded or a toast is held. At most five toasts are kept and three are visible; a sixth removes the oldest.
A swipe of more than 80 px, or a fast flick, throws the toast away. The stack area is 196 px tall and up to 340 px wide.
